metadata.name: AD Ports Group
metadata.provenance: financials built 25-Nov-26 from AD Ports FY2025 & Q3/9M 2026 ADX Financial Statements (Nov-26); quotes await [BBG]

financials_multi_year.source: AD Ports Group FY2025 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements (ADX), read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 rev AED 20.77bn (+20% YoY), EBITDA AED 5.11bn (+13% YoY), NPAT AED 2.07bn (+16% YoY).

financials_multi_year.source: AD Ports Group Q3 & 9M 2026 Unaudited Financial Results (ADX, Nov-26), read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: Q326 rev surged 48% YoY to AED 7.99bn ($2.18bn), Q3 EBITDA +63% to AED 1.97bn (24.6% margin), Q3 NPAT record AED 975m (+64%), 9M NPAT AED 2.46bn. Net debt AED 23.95bn (~$6.5bn) post Oct-26 CLI Brazil acquisition; Net Debt/EBITDA improved sequentially to 3.5x.

capital_structure_tranches.instrument: AD Ports 2.500% Senior Unsecured EMTN due May 2031
capital_structure_tranches.tranche_name: AD Ports 2.500% Senior Unsecured EMTN due May 2031

debt_maturities.source: Reported USD EMTN benchmark bond (total net debt AED 23.95bn / ~$6.5bn includes bank/revolving acquisition facilities).

verdict.stance: Overweight / Accelerating Ports & Maritime Cash Flows Deleveraging to 3.5x (AA- / A1)
verdict.summary: Q3 2026 EBITDA jumped 63% YoY to AED 1.97bn (24.6% margin) and 9M26 net profit hit AED 2.46bn despite Strait of Hormuz disruptions, driving Net Debt/EBITDA sequentially down to 3.5x (AED 23.95bn net debt) even after closing Brazil's CLI Group acquisition on 1-Oct-26.

positives: Strong Abu Dhabi ADQ sovereign backing (AA-/A1) and strategic Khalifa Port + KEZAD monopoly concessions.
Q326 EBITDA surged 63% YoY to AED 1.97bn with 24.6% margin; leverage improving to 3.5x.
Global diversification across Noatum logistics, Spain/Egypt/Angola/Brazil terminals.
negatives: Elevated net debt of AED 23.95bn (~$6.5bn) after aggressive M&A (Noatum, CLI Brazil).
Heavy multi-year capex and Red Sea / Hormuz maritime freight volatility.

background.business_overview: Abu Dhabi integrated ports, industrial zones, maritime shipping, and global logistics operator.
background.asset_perimeter: 5 core clusters: Ports (Khalifa Port, int'l terminals), Maritime & Shipping, Economic Cities & Free Zones (KEZAD), Logistics (Noatum), Digital.
background.ownership_governance: Majority owned by ADQ (Abu Dhabi Sovereign); ADX listed (ADPORTS).

recent_drivers: Nov-26 (Q3/9M26): Q3 rev AED 7.99bn (+48%), Q3 EBITDA AED 1.97bn (+63%), 9M NPAT AED 2.46bn, net debt AED 23.95bn (3.5x).
Oct-26: Completed acquisition of Brazil's CLI Group.

management_guidance_tracker.management_target: Deleverage sequentially from peak M&A cycle
management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Q3 EBITDA +63% YoY accelerated organic deleveraging despite CLI Brazil cash outlay.

management_questions.question: Detail 2027 committed capex and M&A pipeline post-CLI Brazil closing; confirm target Net Debt/EBITDA ceiling.
management_questions.relevance: Key to maintaining standalone investment grade profile alongside ADQ support.

management_questions.question: Quantify Q3/Q4 maritime disruption impact and rerouting surcharges across Red Sea and Gulf lanes.

annotations.note: Q3 rev AED 7.99bn (+48%), EBITDA AED 1.97bn (+63%), 9M NPAT AED 2.46bn; net debt AED 23.95bn (3.5x).

recovery_analysis.thesis: Strategic ADQ infrastructure monopoly with AED 5.1bn+ annual EBITDA.
